verdict.rationale: The evidence points to the building blocks: incidents carry action items (rootly-docs-20), the workflow engine has Jira action types (rootly-docs-17), and the automation docs say tickets get filed (rootly-docs-34). Nothing explicitly shows follow-ups being tracked to completion or synced with an issue tracker, so delivery is implied rather than documented. Missing for 10: documented action-item tracking through to completion, explicit sync of follow-ups to Jira or another tracker (including status sync back), leadership reporting on overdue or open follow-ups, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
